content:
Adds or removes tags from the specified assets, and returns the UUID of the asynchronous asset
update job.
Requires the Basic [16] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
string
Enum: "add"
"remove"
Specifies whether to add or remove tags.
Array of strings <uuid>
A list of asset unique identifiers (UUIDs). For more information on
determining values for this array, see Determine Tag Identifiers.
Array of strings <uuid>
A list of tag value unique identifiers (UUIDs). For more information on
determining values for this array, see Determine Tag Identifiers.
